extra_scents.name: 2-Ethyl-1-hexanol (explosive marker)
extra_scents.desc: Dominant VOC in polymer-based explosives. Or43b / ab8A responds.

extra_scents.name: Nitromethane (explosive precursor)
extra_scents.desc: Used in explosive manufacture. Or42a / pb1A responds.

extra_scents.name: 2,4-Dinitrotoluene (TNT marker)
extra_scents.desc: Degradation product of TNT. Detected by dogs. Drosophila receptor not confirmed in Marshall 2010, extrapolated.

extra_scents.name: Ammonium nitrate (explosive)
extra_scents.desc: Common industrial explosive. Some response via ammonia-sensitive ac1 neurons, extrapolated to ab1C.

extra_scents.name: Benzaldehyde (meth precursor)
extra_scents.desc: Part of one methamphetamine synthesis route. Excites 4+ ORN classes.

extra_scents.name: Phenyl-2-propanone (P2P, meth precursor)
extra_scents.desc: Key methamphetamine synthesis precursor. Marshall 2010 tested, moderate response.

extra_scents.name: Sassafras oil (MDMA precursor)
extra_scents.desc: Natural product. Excites pb2A (Or59c homolog), mapped to pb3A.

extra_scents.name: Acetone (industrial solvent)
extra_scents.desc: Common solvent, also occurs naturally. Detected by multiple ORNs.

extra_scents.name: Radon decay VOCs
extra_scents.desc: Radon is odorless. Flies cannot detect radiation directly. This vector is SPECULATIVE — it represents hypothetical volatile byproducts of radioactive decay. No published ORN data exists.

extra_scents.name: Uranium ore outgassing
extra_scents.desc: Uranium ore releases radon and other gases. SPECULATIVE vector — no Drosophila ORN data. Included for exploratory visualization only.

extra_scents.name: Tritium (H-3) contaminated air
extra_scents.desc: Tritium emits beta particles. No olfactory signal. This vector is a placeholder — included to demonstrate that flies have no receptor pathway for radiation itself.
